```jsx
          to={[{ name: "Laurie McAdam" }]}
          date="Jun 13"
          source="manual"
          subject="We have your home value request, Laurie"
          bodySnippet="Hi Laurie, thanks for reaching out to Ryan Realty…"
          actions={['reply', 'forward', 'more']}
        />
      </TimelineFeed>

      <ScrollToTopFAB visible={scrollY > 300} onClick={scrollToTop} />
    </TimelineColumn>

    {/* RIGHT SIDEBAR */}
    <RightSidebar>
      <SidebarPanel title="Appointments" icon={<CalendarIcon />} canAdd onAdd={openAppointmentModal}>
        <EmptyState text="No upcoming appointments" />
      </SidebarPanel>

      <SidebarPanel title="AgentFire FUB Widget" icon={<DocumentIcon />} collapsible>
        {/* Third-party widget content */}
      </SidebarPanel>

      <SidebarPanel title="Deals" icon={<BriefcaseIcon />} canAdd onAdd={openDealModal}>
        <EmptyState text="No deals yet" />
      </SidebarPanel>

      <SidebarPanel title="Automations" icon={<PlayCircleIcon />} count={1} canAdd onAdd={openAutomationPicker}>
        <AutomationEnrollmentRow
          name="Web Inquiry Option 01"
          startedAt="3 weeks ago"
          status="running"
          onPause={pauseAutomation}
        />
      </SidebarPanel>

      <SidebarPanel title="Files" icon={<PaperclipIcon />} canAdd onAdd={openFileUpload} acceptsDrop>
        <EmptyState text="No files yet, drag some here" />
      </SidebarPanel>

      <SidebarPanel title="Collaborators" icon={<GroupIcon />} canAdd onAdd={openCollaboratorSearch}>
        <EmptyState text="No collaborators" />
      </SidebarPanel>

      <KeyboardNavHint
        nextLabel="view next lead"
        prevLabel="view previous lead"
        nextKey="→"
        prevKey="←"
      />
    </RightSidebar>

  </ThreeColumnLayout>
</ContactDetailPage>
```

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **"via automation" source badge:** Any email entry where `source === 'automation'` renders the gray "via automation" pill AND a "View campaign email" link. Manual emails omit both.

2. **Open count badge:** Only rendered when `openCount > 0`. Color is always green. Text is `"${n} open${n > 1 ? 's' : ''}"`.

3. **Subject "archived":** These automation emails have a literally empty or archived campaign template. The displayed subject is the stored subject of the campaign email step. This is not a UI state — it is the actual email subject that was sent.

4. **BCC to FUB logging address:** The manual email on Jun 13 was BCC'd or CC'd to `ryan.realty@followupboss.me` — this is FUB's email ingestion address (a unique per-account inbound address) that parses the email and logs it to the contact's timeline. The `→` separator shows all recipients in the from→to display.

5. **Sender → Recipient `∨` dropdown:** The dropdown arrow after the recipient name(s) opens an expanded email header panel (To, From, CC, BCC, Reply-To, date/time) without navigating away. This is an inline toggle.

6. **Context menu "Block [email]":** Adds the email to a brokerage-level block/suppress list. FUB will not send outbound emails to this address and will mark inbound emails as blocked. This is scoped to the FUB account, not a Gmail/ESP-level block.

7. **"Share this email with Follow Up Boss staff":** Sends a copy of the email thread to FUB's internal support team, useful for reporting issues (e.g., spam-like content from their drip campaigns, technical failures). This is a FUB product feature for support escalation.

8. **Pixel tracking URL structure:** `https://ryan-realty.com?_pxl=[base64]` — the base64 payload decodes to a structured identifier (person_id, campaign_id, email_send_id). When the recipient opens the email, the tracking pixel fires a GET to this URL, which FUB's server intercepts to increment `open_count`.

9. **Automation status "Running":** FUB action plans have steps with time delays. "Running" means the plan is actively enrolled and awaiting the next scheduled step. The `||` pause button suspends progression through remaining steps for this contact specifically.

10. **Social Profile enrichment:** Age (76), gender (Female), location (Bend, OR) are auto-populated from a third-party data enrichment provider (likely Clearbit, Full Contact, or similar that FUB integrates with). The LinkedIn/Google fields are generated search links, not confirmed user-submitted profiles.

11. **Keyboard navigation (`→`/`←`):** Works relative to the contact's position in the last-active list/smart list view. The context of "next" and "previous" is whatever list the user navigated from.

12. **"Started 3 weeks ago":** This is a relative timestamp. Store absolute `enrolled_at` datetime and compute relative label client-side.

13. **`ryan.realty@followupboss.me` (FUB logging address):** Each FUB account gets a unique inbound email address of the form `[account-slug]@followupboss.me`. Emails sent TO or BCC'd to this address are parsed and logged to the matching contact's timeline by email address matching.
